attribution: ChEMBL data is from https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl; version chembl_37.
scope: approved small-molecule drug to direct human protein mechanism-of-action targets
drug_rules: normalize salts and prodrugs through molecule_hierarchy to the parent molecule
exclude records without a stable ChEMBL molecule identifier or preferred name
target_rules: map target components through target_components and component_sequences
retain only reviewed UniProt accessions that map unambiguously to an approved HGNC symbol
expand protein complexes only to the annotated binding-site component when available; otherwise exclude the complex from the primary analysis
edge_rules: deduplicate at parent ChEMBL molecule and HGNC symbol

require at least 3 targets inside the dataset-specific eligible Bridge universe (revised from 10 after Phase 2 QC showed that only one ChEMBL direct-mechanism drug had 10 targets; use thresholds 2 and 5 as sensitivity analyses)
record action_type and mechanism_of_action but do not infer therapeutic reversal from them
drugbank_decision: not selected: no authorized export exists in the workspace and DrugBank 5.1.22 academic downloads were temporarily paused at freeze time; do not scrape or substitute DrugBank identifiers
comparability_note: This is a ChEMBL mechanism-target enrichment benchmark, not an exact DrugBank replication. The target-count threshold differs from the DrugBank study because the direct ChEMBL mechanism graph is intentionally narrower.

phase2_qc_amendment.critical_validity_error: The frozen >=10-target rule retained only one drug (regorafenib), making comparative enrichment and convergence undefined.
phase2_qc_amendment.resolution: Primary threshold lowered to >=3 eligible direct mechanism targets (63 drugs); >=2 (223 drugs) and >=5 (10 drugs) are prespecified sensitivity analyses. Resource, edge definition, and all dataset choices/contrasts remain unchanged.
phase2_qc_amendment.checksum_correction: The Phase 1 manifest accidentally recorded the SHA-256 for chembl_37.fps.gz. Phase 2 acquired the 5,764,252,857-byte SQLite archive and corrected its filename-specific official SHA-256 to 33c203740555f96067710cdfc1c3c55d890660e5908ec5cbf5817492c290d281.
